description: Customized, one-time, high-emotion purchase. Opaque prices, plentiful alternatives, zero buyer leverage and zero time. The buyer describes what she wants once; the agents shop and haggle.

specFields.prompt: What silhouette are you looking for?
Any fabric preference (satin, lace, tulle, crepe)?
Sleeve style (strapless, long sleeve, cap, off-shoulder)?
Any customization (custom measurements, added sleeves, color change)?

priceBenchmark.note: Ground truth for red-flag detection. Replace with a live benchmark feed for production.

redFlags.message: Quote is 30%+ below the median — verify authenticity, fabric quality, real photos, sizing accuracy, and return policy before trusting. Common in dropship knock-offs.
No returns / final sale on a made-to-order gown magnifies sizing risk — flag it.
Lead time unstated or 'it depends' — pin down a firm ship-by date against the wedding date.

callListSource.query: bridal boutique OR wedding dress shop
callListSource.note: Also supports direct-to-consumer online sellers via their listed customer-service lines.

counterpartyStyles.description: Holds firm on price, pushes deposits, tests whether the buyer is serious.
'We only give pricing after an in-store appointment' — must extract a range or a firm callback.
Bundles alterations, veils, rush fees; inflates the total. Agent must itemize and strip non-essentials.

disclosure: Hi, this is an AI assistant calling on behalf of a customer who's shopping for a wedding dress. Happy to say up front that I'm an AI — I'm just gathering some pricing and availability. Is now an okay time for a couple of quick questions?
